elements.text:
Map an SSW hull role to a reviewed EVE role group.

Normalize the group median around an SSW anchor, then damp and bound the ratio.

46 hull prices change; unmapped hulls keep their prior values.

Physical mass, thrust, reactor output and geometry are not copied.

role_ratio = eve_role_median / eve_frigate_median
within_role = old_price / old_ssw_class_median
candidate = 574000 * role_ratio**0.75 * role_factor * within_role
new_price = round1000(clamp(candidate, 0.5*old_price, 2*old_price))

# Formula summary; Falcon stays fixed at 574,000 SSW credits
